description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A spell you cast would move the needle toward the side you are not on.

Instead of moving one step, the needle snaps immediately to any position on the opposite side, up to your cap. This counts as crossing zero for everything that responds to a crossing, including Turn. You may do this once per round; the needle's ordinary one-step movement applies on every other occasion, and this does not let you move the needle without casting.
